channel.description: Deep exploration of AI ethics and its intersection with Psychology, Philosophy, and Sociology.

item.title: Supervised Thought: AI's Rule-based Training vs. Unchecked Learning In Humans
item.description: At the surface, AI's rule based training seems similar to human methods and it is—to a degree. Dig into the nuances to see how humans overcomplicate things while AI models literally can't.

item.title: AI models are generating religious outputs
item.description: AI models are increasingly outputting responses that border on spiritual or religious. In this piece, we outline why that is and what it says about human data as a whole.
